title: Nova Weekly Product Sync — Sample Recording
provenance: Original fictional dialogue written for this repository and synthesized locally with Windows SAPI. No third-party audio, transcript or copyrighted material is used. Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.

lines.speaker: Mina
lines.text: Let's keep this to ten minutes. We need to decide the onboarding release date and who owns the accessibility fixes.

lines.speaker: Deniz
lines.text: The transcript QA edge cases are fixed, but the invite email still fails for guests on mobile. I can close that by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: I reviewed the new empty state. The contrast is still below the target, so I will ship a darker variant tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: Mina
lines.text: Decision: we ship onboarding version two next Tuesday, as long as the guest invite fix lands by Thursday and the contrast issue is closed. Deniz owns the invite fix, Alex owns contrast. I will write the release note on Friday.

lines.speaker: Deniz
lines.text: One risk: the translation vendor has not confirmed the Turkish strings. If they slip, we launch English only and add Turkish in the following patch.

lines.speaker: Mina
lines.text: Agreed. Let's record that as a risk and keep the English-only fallback in the release note.
